headline: Last session: Indian markets closed higher as gains in major blue-chips offset concerns over weather and macro headwinds.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.

why: Gains in key benchmark heavyweights supported positive momentum in the last trading session.
Investors monitored global macroeconomic signals and geopolitical developments.
Concerns over potential monsoon deficits and agricultural impact kept sentiment cautious in select sectors.
Stock-specific news flow and contract updates drove selective buying and selling.
whatHappening: NTPC terminated a 400 MWh battery energy storage system contract awarded to G R Infraprojects.
DLF announced plans to open a ₹500 crore mall in Goa by March 2027 to boost annual rental income.
Reports of El Nino threatening Rabi crops raised concerns over agricultural productivity.
Markets are closed for the weekend and will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.
